prompt:
Create one landscape PNG raster illustration, native approximately 16:9 (about 1672 x 941). Friendly, warm, clear abstract hand-drawn comic style matching SkillPilot science learning illustrations: soft cream/pale blue background, rounded dark-blue outlines, a few generous colorful shapes and calm composition. Scientifically sound, never photorealistic, never sterile technical CAD. Main idea and critical details must remain clear at 360px total displayed width, and at 680px. No tiny letters, decorative writing, equations, logos, watermark, caption or textual labels. Use large motifs, sufficient white space. This is an author candidate, not quality approval. 
Actual bilingual learning-goal context (do not typeset this): Evolution des Menschen nachvollziehen — Die lernende Person kann Fossilgeschichte, hypothetische Stammbäume und Verbreitung des modernen Menschen beschreiben. / Trace human evolution — The learner can describe the fossil record, hypothetical phylogenetic trees, and the spread of modern humans.
Scene: Illustrate the fossil record, branching hypothetical phylogeny and geographic spread of modern humans. A friendly adult archaeologist at lower left studies a large fossil skull in a display tray. In the central/right main motif a broad clearly branching ancestry tree starts from a common ancestor and splits into several branches: two end in different simplified fossil skull silhouettes and one ends in a diverse small group of modern humans. All living people belong to that same terminal modern-human branch; never place ethnic groups on different evolutionary levels or species branches. No linear ape-to-human march, no progress ladder, no claim that modern monkeys evolved into humans. A small but clear secondary globe silhouette at upper right depicts Africa and neighboring continents with broad dispersal arrows originating in Africa, no exact dates or route detail, no invented cartographic labels. Keep the tree as a conceptual hypothesis with uncluttered thick branches; no fixed named species relationships or numerical scientific claims. Respectful, inclusive people and fossil characters.
